role: TS/natural onset progress weight
calibration_source: unity, not fitted; the natural branch's one measured quantity is N_anchor, set on Schubauer-Skramstad alone, and the 86 NLF(1)-0416 conditions are out of sample

role: bypass onset weight
calibration_source: unity; validated on ERCOFTAC T3A/T3A-/T3B

role: separation-induced weight
calibration_source: unity; validated on T3C4 and NLF(1)-0416 lower surface

role: crossflow weight
calibration_source: unity; Arnal C1 criterion

role: e^N amplification factor
calibration_source: Mack N=-8.43-2.4 ln(Tu), clamped to 0.0008<=Tu<=0.0298, anchored -1.10 (FITTED jointly on S&S and 86 aerofoil pts); 7.58 for Tu<0.08%

role: lower clamp on N_crit at high Tu
calibration_source: clamp; bypass governs there

role: Tu [%] below which the bypass correlation carries no weight
calibration_source: lower edge of the natural/bypass blend; below it the e^N branch alone governs

role: Tu [%] above which the bypass correlation carries all the weight
calibration_source: upper edge of the same blend.  Replaces the single Tu_TS_max gate, which made the predicted transition location a step function of Tu; the window is wider than the spread of any case here, so no result in this study is blended

role: transition-length scale, Re_lambda = C_len Re_x_t^0.75
calibration_source: Dhawan & Narasimha (1958) published value; not fitted here

role: crossflow critical Re_theta2
calibration_source: Arnal et al.; facility-dependent: 150 fits Dagenhart (14.7%), 200 fits Boltz (18.4%)

role: crossflow closed by an amplification integral, not a local threshold
calibration_source: rate computed (0.0435); threshold is the same N_crit; adds no constant

role: theta2/theta surrogate for crossflow
calibration_source: FITTED on Dagenhart & Saric; independent check in Sec. IV.C

role: shear-layer amplification rate in a bubble
calibration_source: computed on the reverse-flow Falkner-Skan branch; 0.0435, not fitted

role: two-equation laminar march (momentum + kinetic energy)
calibration_source: closures from the Falkner-Skan family; no fitted constant

role: offset on Mack's N_crit
calibration_source: unit conversion from Mack's 1977 growth rates to the present tabulated ones; set on the Schubauer-Skramstad plate ALONE, which it reproduces to 0.07 %. It was previously set jointly on that plate and the 86 NLF(1)-0416 conditions, which made that set a calibration set while three places in this project described it as one on which nothing is calibrated

role: k-epsilon constant in the free-stream turbulence decay
calibration_source: standard value 0.09; with C_eps2 it fixes Tu(x) from the rig's integral length scale, and neither is fitted here

role: k-epsilon constant in the free-stream turbulence decay
calibration_source: standard value 1.92; sets the decay exponent of isotropic grid turbulence

role: separation branch closed by marching the detached shear layer
calibration_source: True is the model; False is the 'no bubble closure' ablation

role: amplification rates read from the tabulated Orr-Sommerfeld solutions
calibration_source: True is the model; False selects the Drela-Giles envelope fit, the third ablation

role: exact Falkner-Skan-Cooke K(lambda) in place of the constant surrogate (ablation path only)
calibration_source: False is the model; True was tried and is reported in Sec. IV.C, where it makes the two swept wings agree less, not more

role: shape factor in the dead-air momentum equation follows the reverse-flow profile (ablation path only)
calibration_source: False is the model; True relaxes the cap at the attached Falkner-Skan separation value onto the reverse-flow profile the amplification rate is already read from, and moves T3C4 by 0.8 points and the 86 aerofoil conditions by 0.0004c - see 06_validation/bubble_diagnostics.csv

role: declare laminar separation on the solved shape factor instead of on lambda (ablation path only)
calibration_source: 0 = use lam_sep; the shape-factor test is the more principled statement but the aerofoil measurements reject it - see the note in march_bl

role: weight on the flow-history average of Tu, Tu_eff = Tu_avg^w Tu_local^(1-w)
calibration_source: FITTED on the three ERCOFTAC plates; no effect where Tu does not decay

role: Thwaites parameter at laminar separation
calibration_source: Thwaites (1949) published value; not fitted

role: min separation-induced onset Re_theta (ablation path only)
calibration_source: superseded by the bubble closure; reachable only with bubble=False

role: max ratio between adjacent frequencies in the e^N integration
calibration_source: discretisation, stated as a RESOLUTION rather than a count: with a fixed count of 40 the Schubauer-Skramstad onset moved 5 % between 24 and 64 frequencies and did not settle.  At this spacing Re_x,tr is unchanged from 1.10 down to 1.0075

role: floor on the frequency count
calibration_source: guards a degenerate range

role: cap on the frequency count
calibration_source: guards a degenerate range

role: separate amplification threshold for the crossflow branch (ablation path only)
calibration_source: 0 = use the same N_crit as every other branch; exposed to test whether a roughness-seeded branch needs its own threshold, and it does not - see 06_validation/crossflow_criticals_summary.csv
